name: arya-warm
notes: Audition variant of the user-approved custom-2, for stock pads. Keeps its bass filters but gently lowers upper mids and treble: about 1 dB less at 2 kHz and 2-3 dB less at 8-12 kHz. A darker, softer-edged option, not a hearing-safety setting. Raw device Q. All five arya audition presets use -11.5 dB preamp, 1.5 dB below custom-2; equal preamp is not perceptual loudness matching. Modeled headroom only; not acoustically verified or auditioned.
